title: Procedural Plant Generator preset
description: One plant (tree, cactus, rosette succulent, flower, vine, vegetable, grass, orchid) or fruit described by measurable traits. See docs/PRESETS.md.

id.description: Unique lower_snake_case identifier (becomes the preset key).

base.description: Built-in or library preset of the same growth form to start from; 'preset' then lists only the differences.

default_flower.description: Flower preset id shown on this plant.

default_fruit.description: Fruit preset id borne by this plant (Tree, Vine).

dbh_min_m.description: Stem diameter at breast height (DBH, at 1.3m) reference and boundaries in meters

dbh_max_m.description: Largest stem diameter at breast height (1.3 m) for the species, metres.

dbh_default_m.description: Stem diameter at 1.3 m used by default; sets height and crown through the allometric laws. Mature broadleaves 0.4-1.0 m.

crown_radius_d.description: Exponent d of the crown radius law CR = c * (DBH_cm)^d (typically 0.45-0.65).

crown_depth_ratio.description: Crown depth ratio: Crown Length / Total Height (typically 0.40 - 0.75)

pipe_exponent_delta.description: Leonardo da Vinci's rule / Murray pipe model exponent: r_parent^delta = sum(r_children^delta) Pure Leonardo = 2.0; empirical trees under wind load = 2.1 - 2.6

buttress_lobes.description: Gielis symmetry m of the fluted base (0 = round)

AllometricProfile.description: Empirical scaling parameters for a plant or tree taxon.

model.description: Hallé-Oldeman architectural model: Rauh (rhythmic orthotropic, oaks, pines), Massart (horizontal tiers, firs), Troll (plagiotropic axes erect at the tip, beech, elm), Attims (continuous branching, eucalyptus), Corner (unbranched with apical crown, palms).

phyllotaxis.description: Arrangement of leaves and branches along a shoot: Spiral (alternate), Decussate (opposite pairs, maples, ash), Distichous (two ranks), Whorled. Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

max_order.description: 0 = trunk only, 1 = scaffolds, 2 = branches, 3 = twigs, 4 = shoots Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

branch_angle_mean_deg.description: Scaffold insertion angle from the parent axis Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

branch_angle_std_deg.description: Standard deviation of the scaffold branch angle, degrees (natural irregularity, 4-10). Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

twig_angle_mean_deg.description: Higher-order insertion angle Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

divergence_angle_deg.description: Angle between successive lateral organs around the axis, degrees: 137.5 spiral (golden angle), 180 distichous, 90 decussate. Applies when: model != 'Corner' and phyllotaxis == 'Spiral'.

whorl_size.description: Laterals per node Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

gravitropism.description: < 0 bends up, > 0 weeping Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

phototropism.description: Outward (light-seeking) bias of laterals Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

plagiotropy.description: 0 = laterals spiral in 3D, 1 = flattened horizontal sprays Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

internode_length_base_m.description: Length of a growth unit on the main axes, metres (0.2-0.8 for trees). Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

internode_decay_per_order.description: Child / parent length ratio Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

branch_frequency_per_meter.description: Scaffold nodes per meter of crown axis Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

crookedness.description: Tortuosity of the axes, 0 straight .. 0.6 very winding (olive, old oaks).

crown_widest_position.description: Relative height (0 bottom .. 1 top of the crown) where the crown is widest: ~0.2 conical, 0.4-0.5 rounded, 0.7 vase. Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

crown_fullness.description: Shape of the beta crown envelope: < 1 columnar / flat sides, 1.5 rounded, > 2 peaked. Applies when: model != 'Corner'.

leaf_area_index.description: One-sided leaf area per unit crown projection area

archetype.description: Leaf-shape template (Ellis et al. 2009 vocabulary); individual descriptors below refine it.

margin_type.description: Leaf margin: Entire, Serrate, Dentate, Crenate, Doubly serrate, ... (sets tooth shape).

blade_length_cm.description: Lamina (or leaflet / needle) size and outline

base_angle_deg.description: Angle enclosed by the base (acute < 90 < obtuse)

lobe_count.description: Palmate: total lobes. Pinnate: lobes per side Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

lobe_depth.description: Sinus depth: 0 = unlobed, 1 = to the midvein Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

lobe_angle_deg.description: Pinnate lobe divergence from the midvein Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

lobe_spread_deg.description: Palmate: total angle between outermost lobes

lobe_width.description: Lobe breadth relative to its angular sector Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

lobe_roundness.description: Sinus rounding (0 = V sinus, 1 = U sinus) Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

lobe_apex_angle_deg.description: Apex angle of each lobe Applies when: lobe_type != 'None'.

teeth_count.description: Teeth per side along one lamina Applies when: margin_type != 'Entire'.

tooth_height_ratio.description: Tooth depth relative to lamina width Applies when: margin_type != 'Entire'.

tooth_skew.description: 0.5 symmetric (dentate) .. 0.9 strongly forward Applies when: margin_type != 'Entire'.

leaflet_count.description: Pinnate: pairs. Palmate/fascicle: total. Spray: per side Applies when: compound_type != 'Simple'.

leaflet_angle_deg.description: Leaflet / needle angle from rachis Applies when: compound_type in ('Pinnate', 'Spray').

rachis_length_ratio.description: Rachis length / leaflet length Applies when: compound_type in ('Pinnate', 'Spray').

leaflet_size_gradient.description: Basal leaflets smaller by this fraction Applies when: compound_type != 'Simple'.

petiole_angle_deg.description: Insertion angle between petiole and shoot

mean_leaf_angle_deg.description: Mean lamina inclination from horizontal (planophile ~25, spherical ~57, erectophile ~70)

transverse_curl.description: Curl of the blade across its width, 0 flat .. 1 strongly folded along the midrib.

longitudinal_droop.description: Downward bending of the blade along its length, 0 straight .. 1 drooping.

undulation_amplitude.description: Waviness of the margin, 0 flat .. 0.5 strongly undulate.

abaxial_color.description: Colour of the lower leaf surface, sRGB 0..1 (usually paler than the upper).

gloss.description: Glossiness of the upper surface, 0 matt .. 1 waxy (Ficus, Magnolia).

LeafMorphologyProfile.description: Measurable leaf descriptors. Lengths are relative to blade length unless noted.

pattern.description: Secondary venation pattern (Ellis et al. 2009): craspedodromous (veins end in teeth), brochidodromous (looping), actinodromous (palmate), parallelodromous (monocots), ...

basal_angle_increase_deg.description: Secondaries diverge wider near the base

primary_radius_mm.description: Half-width of the midrib in the leaf texture, millimetres.

secondary_curvature.description: 0 = straight, 1 = strongly arcuate toward the apex

vein_contrast.description: Visual prominence of veins in the texture

leaf_mass_per_area_g_m2.description: LMA from Dryad UCBG 122spp dataset (30 - 250 g/m^2)

BiomechanicalProfile.description: Mechanical material properties for plant stems and foliage.

pattern.description: Rhytidome type (Junikka 1994): Smooth, Fissured (furrowed ridges), Plated (scales/plates), Peeling (exfoliating patches), Lenticelled (horizontal lenticels), Fibrous (stringy strips), Annulated (leaf-scar rings).

feature_scale_m.description: Characteristic spacing of ridges, plates, lenticels

roughness.description: Surface roughness of the bark material, 0 glossy .. 1 rough (bark is typically 0.75-0.95).

young_color.description: Periderm of young shoots (sRGB); derived when None

onset_radius_cm.description: Axis radius (cm) where the mature bark pattern replaces the smooth young periderm; fissures widen beyond it.

inner_color.description: Exposed inner bark at the bottom of fissures

blockiness.description: 0 irregular, rounded cells .. 1 rectangular blocks (Minkowski exponent) Applies when: pattern in ('Fissured', 'Plated', 'Annulated').

segments.description: Transverse splits cutting ridges into segments (blocky oak, Ulmus) Applies when: pattern in ('Fissured', 'Plated', 'Fibrous').

plate_tilt.description: Per-plate tilt / offset (scales and plates catching light differently) Applies when: pattern in ('Fissured', 'Plated', 'Annulated').

warp.description: Organic distortion; high = interlacing, anastomosing ridges (Fraxinus, Tilia)

moss.description: Moss cover (upper sides, base, shaded side)

lichen.description: Crustose lichen patches (favoured on smooth bark)

BarkProfile.description: BarkProfile(pattern: core.bark.BarkPattern = <BarkPattern.FISSURED: 'Fissured'>, base_color: tuple = (0.3, 0.25, 0.2), secondary_color: tuple = (0.16, 0.13, 0.1), feature_scale_m: float = 0.08, relief: float = 0.6, roughness: float = 0.85, young_color: tuple = None, onset_radius_cm: float = 4.0, inner_color: tuple = None, weathering: float = 0.35, blockiness: float = 0.4, segments: float = 0.3, plate_tilt: float = 0.3, warp: float = 0.4, moss: float = 0.15, lichen: float = 0.15)

system.description: Root system type (Köstler et al. 1968): Taproot, Heart, Plate (shallow), Fibrous, Buttress, Tuberous.

lateral_count.description: Main structural laterals (= buttress count when buttressed) Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

spread_crown_ratio.description: Lateral reach / crown radius Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

max_depth_m.description: Species/biome maximum rooting depth Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

beta.description: Jackson vertical distribution coefficient Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

taproot_share.description: Fraction of the collar pipe flow taken by the taproot / obliques Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

zrt_dbh_ratio.description: Zone of rapid taper radius / DBH Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

sinker_spacing_m.description: Mean distance between sinkers along laterals Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

branch_spacing_m.description: Mean distance between second-order laterals Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

surface_exposure.description: 0 buried .. 1 laterals ride on the soil surface near the stem Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

plank.description: Vertical elongation of lateral cross-sections near the stem Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

buttress_height_dbh.description: Height on the stem where laterals/buttresses merge (x DBH) Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

tortuosity.description: Winding of the roots through the soil, 0 straight .. 1 very tortuous. Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

knees.description: Pneumatophores ("cypress knees") on shallow laterals Applies when: system not in ('Fibrous', 'Tuberous').

fibrous_radius_m.description: Radius of the fine fibrous roots, metres. Applies when: system == 'Fibrous'.

fibrous_spread_m.description: Horizontal reach of fibrous roots (0 = 1-3 m, palms) Applies when: system == 'Fibrous'.

tuber_length_m.description: TUBEROUS storage root Applies when: system == 'Tuberous'.

tuber_radius_m.description: Radius of a storage tuber (Tuberous system), metres. Applies when: system == 'Tuberous'.

RootProfile.description: RootProfile(system: core.roots.RootSystemType = <RootSystemType.HEART: 'Heart'>, lateral_count: int = 6, spread_crown_ratio: float = 1.4, max_depth_m: float = 3.0, beta: float = 0.966, taproot_share: float = 0.15, zrt_dbh_ratio: float = 2.2, sinker_spacing_m: float = 1.2, branch_spacing_m: float = 0.9, surface_exposure: float = 0.15, plank: float = 0.5, buttress_height_dbh: float = 0.6, tortuosity: float = 0.25, knees: int = 0, fibrous_count: int = 60, fibrous_radius_m: float = 0.006, fibrous_spread_m: float = 0.0, tuber_length_m: float = 0.12, tuber_radius_m: float = 0.03)

scientific_name.description: Binomial name, e.g. 'Quercus robur' (shown in the UI and object names).

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

deciduous.description: True if the tree sheds its leaves seasonally (enables autumn colour).

TreePreset.description: Trait values of a Tree preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

habit.description: Body plan: Columnar (saguaro, organ pipe), Barrel, Globose, Cladode (Opuntia pads).

arrangement.description: Areole layout: Ribs (on rib crests) or Tubercles (spiral lattice of podaria, Mammillaria). Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

diameter_m.description: Stem diameter, metres (main trunk for branched species). Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

base_taper.description: Narrowing toward the ground (fraction of radius) Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

apex_dome.description: Dome height in stem radii Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

apex_roundness.description: Superellipse exponent of the dome (2 = elliptic, >2 = flat-topped) Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

apex_depression.description: Sunken apex (fraction of radius) Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

rib_count.description: Ribs and tubercles Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

rib_depth.description: Groove depth relative to radius Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arrangement == 'Ribs'.

rib_sharpness.description: < 1 rounded crests, > 1 sharp crests Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arrangement == 'Ribs'.

rib_twist_deg_per_m.description: Helical twist of the ribs, degrees per metre of height (0 straight). Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

tubercle_height.description: Relative bump raised by each areole Applies when: habit != 'Cladode'.

areole_spacing_cm.description: Distance between neighbouring areoles along a rib or in the lattice, cm.

radial_length_cm.description: Length of the radial spines, cm.

central_spines.description: Number of central spines per areole.

central_length_cm.description: Length of the central spines, cm. Applies when: central_spines > 0.

central_hook.description: Terminal hook on centrals (Ferocactus wislizeni, Mammillaria) Applies when: central_spines > 0.

radial_lift_deg.description: Angle of radials above the surface

spine_jitter.description: Random variation of spine direction and length, 0 regular .. 1 messy.

wool.description: Areolar wool / felt size (relative to spacing)

apical_wool.description: Extra wool on the apex (Echinocactus grusonii, cephalia)

arm_height_min.description: Relative height range of arm insertions Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_height_max.description: Highest arm insertion, as a fraction of the stem height. Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_radius_ratio.description: Arm radius relative to the trunk radius. Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_reach_m.description: Horizontal elbow before turning upward Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_length_ratio.description: Vertical rise of an arm relative to the main stem height Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_lean_deg.description: Outward lean of the erect part of each arm Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

arm_branching.description: Mean number of secondary arms per arm (dense candelabra crowns). Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

crown_fill.description: Fraction of arms whose columns fill the crown disc (area-uniform) instead of a ring      # Mean secondary arms per arm (dense candelabra crowns) Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and arm_count > 0.

offset_scale.description: Size of basal offsets (pups) relative to the mother stem. Applies when: habit != 'Cladode' and offsets > 0.

pad_width_ratio.description: Cladode width / length (Opuntia ~0.6). Applies when: habit == 'Cladode'.

pad_thickness_ratio.description: Cladode thickness / length (Opuntia ~0.06). Applies when: habit == 'Cladode'.

pad_levels.description: Number of cladode generations in the chain (plant age / height). Applies when: habit == 'Cladode'.

pad_branching.description: Mean daughter pads per pad Applies when: habit == 'Cladode'.

groove_color.description: Colour at the bottom of the grooves between ribs, sRGB 0..1.

spine_color.description: Spine colour at the base, sRGB 0..1.

spine_tip_color.description: Spine colour at the tip, sRGB 0..1.

wool_color.description: Colour of areolar and apical wool, sRGB 0..1.

browning_height_m.description: Height reached by epidermal browning (bark) on the equatorial side

equator_bias.description: How much higher it climbs on the equator-facing side Applies when: browning_height_m > 0.

equator_azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth (from +X, counter-clockwise) of the equator-facing side Applies when: browning_height_m > 0.

scaling_color.description: Colour of early epidermal browning ('scaling', tan to red-orange), sRGB 0..1. Applies when: browning_height_m > 0.

barking_color.description: Colour of old epidermal bark ('barking', dark brown or grey), sRGB 0..1. Applies when: browning_height_m > 0.

scar_color.description: Colour of corky scars, sRGB 0..1. Applies when: scars > 0.

areole_stain.description: Dark halos and drip streaks below the areoles

groove_dust.description: Soil and dust in the grooves and near the ground

root_system.description: Roots (Cannon 1911; Snyman 2005): shallow laterals, optional taproot or napiform tuber

root_spread_ratio.description: Lateral reach relative to plant height

taproot_share.description: Fraction of the root collar taken by a taproot (0 none .. 0.8 dominant taproot).

tuber_length_cm.description: Length of a napiform storage tuber (peyote), cm. Applies when: root_system == 'Tuberous'.

tuber_radius_ratio.description: Tuber radius relative to stem radius Applies when: root_system == 'Tuberous'.

form.description: Growth form; must match the envelope's growth_form ('Cactus' or 'Rosette').

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

CactusPreset.description: Trait values of a Cactus preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

phyllotaxis.description: Leaf arrangement: Spiral (golden angle, most rosettes) or Distichous (two ranks, Gasteria).

leaf_count.description: Number of living leaves in the rosette.

stem_height_m.description: Visible stem below the rosette (Aeonium: tall)

stem_radius_m.description: Stem radius under the rosette, metres.

rosette_height_m.description: Vertical spread of leaf insertions along the stem

leaf_length_cm.description: Length of the outermost mature leaves, cm.

size_gradient.description: Youngest leaves smaller by this fraction

elevation_outer_deg.description: Elevation of the oldest, outer leaves above horizontal, degrees.

elevation_inner_deg.description: Elevation of the youngest, central leaves, degrees (near 90 = erect spike).

elevation_power.description: How quickly leaves become erect toward the centre

curvature_deg.description: Bending along the leaf (+ incurved upward, - recurved)

widest_position.description: Position of the widest point along the leaf, 0 base .. 1 tip.

base_angle_deg.description: Angle enclosed by the leaf margins at the base, degrees.

apex_angle_deg.description: Angle enclosed by the leaf margins at the apex, degrees (small = acuminate).

base_curvature.description: Curvature of the basal margin, -1 concave .. +1 convex.

apex_curvature.description: Curvature of the apical margin, -1 concave (acuminate) .. +1 rounded.

base_width.description: Half-width at the insertion relative to the widest point

clasp.description: How much the base wraps around the stem (sheathing / clasping)

base_swell.description: Extra thickness of the fleshy leaf base

furl.description: Rolling of young central leaves into the spike (cogollo)

dead_leaves.description: Persistent dry leaves below the living rosette (skirt)

dead_color.description: Colour of withered leaves, sRGB 0..1. Applies when: dead_leaves > 0.

stem_scars.description: Visibility of crescent leaf scars on the stem Applies when: stem_height_m > 0.

scar_spacing_mm.description: Internode length along the bare stem Applies when: stem_height_m > 0.

terminal_spine_cm.description: Length of the terminal leaf spine (Agave), cm; 0 = none.

teeth_size_cm.description: Size of the marginal teeth, cm; 0 = none. Applies when: teeth_count > 0.

teeth_hook.description: How much marginal teeth curve toward the leaf tip, 0 straight .. 1 hooked. Applies when: teeth_count > 0.

offsets.description: Number of offsets (pups) around the main rosette.

offset_scale.description: Size of the offsets relative to the main rosette. Applies when: offsets > 0.

blush_color.description: Anthocyanin blush colour of margins and tips, sRGB 0..1. Applies when: blush_amount > 0.

armature_color.description: Colour of spines and teeth, sRGB 0..1.

blush_tip.description: Weight of the tip in the blush (0 = margins only) Applies when: blush_amount > 0.

imprints.description: Bud imprints of neighbouring leaves' teeth and outline (Agave)

root_depth_m.description: Rooting depth holding 90% of the roots, metres.

root_radius_mm.description: Root radius at the collar, mm.

form.description: Growth form; must match the envelope's growth_form ('Cactus' or 'Rosette').

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

RosettePreset.description: Trait values of a Rosette preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

arrangement.description: Floral diagram Applies when: not capitulum.

merosity.description: Organs per whorl Applies when: not capitulum.

petal_whorls.description: > 1: double flowers (extra petal whorls replace stamens) Applies when: not capitulum and arrangement == 'Whorled'.

spiral_tepals.description: Perianth organs when spiral (Magnolia, cactus, double rose) Applies when: not capitulum and arrangement == 'Spiral'.

zygomorphy.description: 0 radial symmetry .. 1 strongly bilateral Applies when: not capitulum.

lip_bias.description: + dorsal organs larger (standard), - ventral lip larger Applies when: not capitulum and zygomorphy > 0.

petals_visible.description: False: perianth reduced or shed (Eucalyptus operculum, catkin flowers) Applies when: not capitulum.

widest_position.description: Position of the widest point of the petal, 0 base .. 1 tip.

base_angle_deg.description: Angle enclosed by the petal margins at the base, degrees.

apex_angle_deg.description: Angle enclosed by the petal margins at the apex, degrees (180 = truncate).

apex_curvature.description: Curvature of the petal apex, -1 acuminate .. +1 rounded.

claw.description: Narrow stalk-like base (unguiculate petals), fraction of length

fringe_count.description: Number of teeth or fringe lobes at the petal apex. Applies when: fringe > 0.

opening_deg.description: Elevation of the organ base above the floral plane (90 = erect)

reflex_deg.description: Bending along the organ (+ incurved, - reflexed)

inner_scale.description: Size of innermost perianth organ relative to outer (spiral / double)

inner_opening_deg.description: Elevation of innermost perianth organs (spiral / double)

tube_length_cm.description: Corolla tube (sympetaly) Applies when: not capitulum.

tube_radius_cm.description: At the base Applies when: not capitulum and tube_length_cm > 0.

tube_flare.description: Exponent of the tube profile (1 conical, >1 trumpet) Applies when: not capitulum and tube_length_cm > 0.

limb_fusion.description: Fused limb: lobes widen to fill their sector (1 = entire rim, Ipomoea) Applies when: not capitulum and tube_length_cm > 0.

sepal_length_ratio.description: Relative to petal length (0 = no visible calyx) Applies when: not capitulum.

sepal_aspect.description: Sepal length / width. Applies when: not capitulum and sepal_length_ratio > 0.

sepal_opening_deg.description: Elevation of the sepals above the floral plane, degrees (negative = reflexed). Applies when: not capitulum and sepal_length_ratio > 0.

hypanthium_cm.description: Floral cup / inferior ovary below the perianth (cactus pericarpel) Applies when: not capitulum.

hypanthium_scales.description: Bract scales on it (cactus pericarpel) Applies when: not capitulum and hypanthium_cm > 0.

stamen_length_ratio.description: Stamen length relative to the petal length. Applies when: not capitulum and stamen_count > 0.

stamen_spread_deg.description: Outward tilt of the stamens from the floral axis, degrees. Applies when: not capitulum and stamen_count > 0.

anther_size_mm.description: Anther length, mm. Applies when: not capitulum and stamen_count > 0.

staminal_column.description: Monadelphous column (Hibiscus): fraction of stamen length fused Applies when: not capitulum and stamen_count > 0.

stamen_declination.description: Stamens curve toward the dorsal side (zygomorphic flowers) Applies when: not capitulum and stamen_count > 0.

carpels.description: Stigma lobes Applies when: not capitulum and style_length_ratio > 0.

style_length_ratio.description: Style length relative to the petal length (0 = no visible pistil). Applies when: not capitulum.

stigma_size_mm.description: Size of each stigma lobe, mm. Applies when: not capitulum and style_length_ratio > 0.

receptacle_radius_cm.description: Radius of the receptacle (floral base), cm.

receptacle_height_cm.description: > radius: conical receptacle (Magnolia gynoecium) Applies when: not capitulum.

disc_florets.description: Number of disc florets in a capitulum (sunflower ~1000). Applies when: capitulum.

disc_radius_cm.description: Radius of the capitulum disc, cm. Applies when: capitulum.

disc_dome.description: Doming of the disc, 0 flat .. 1 hemispherical. Applies when: capitulum.

ray_count.description: Ray florets; spread over the whole head when ray_fill > 0 (double) Applies when: capitulum.

ray_fill.description: 0 one rim row .. 1 rays fill the head (Dahlia, Tagetes) Applies when: capitulum.

involucre_bracts.description: Number of involucral bracts (phyllaries) under a capitulum. Applies when: capitulum.

tip_color.description: Petal colour at the tip (gradient from petal_color), sRGB 0..1.

tip_start.description: Where the tip colour starts along the petal

eye_color.description: Colour of the contrasting zone at the petal base (eye) and of nectar guides, sRGB 0..1.

eye_size.description: Contrasting base zone (0..1 of the perianth length)

guide_contrast.description: Strength of the nectar guides, 0 none .. 1 strong. Applies when: guide_lines > 0.

spots.description: Dark spots on the inner perianth (Lilium, Aesculus)

spot_color.description: Colour of petal spots (Lilium), sRGB 0..1. Applies when: spots > 0.

outer_color.description: Outer tepals / sepaloid gradient Applies when: outer_tint > 0.

outer_tint.description: Strength of the outer_color tint on outer tepals (sepaloid gradient), 0..1.

sepal_color.description: Colour of sepals, bracts and the floral cup, sRGB 0..1.

pistil_color.description: Style, stigma and receptacle colour, sRGB 0..1.

disc_color.description: Colour of mature disc florets (capitulum rim), sRGB 0..1. Applies when: capitulum.

disc_center_color.description: Colour of the young central disc florets, sRGB 0..1. Applies when: capitulum.

translucency.description: Light transmission of the petals, 0 opaque .. 1 thin and translucent.

kind.description: Inflorescence type: Solitary, Raceme, Spike, Catkin, Umbel, Corymb, Panicle (Weberling 1989).

flower_count.description: Number of flowers (per panicle branch counts are derived). Applies when: kind != 'Solitary'.

rachis_cm.description: Flower-bearing axis Applies when: kind not in ('Solitary', 'Umbel').

pedicel_cm.description: Length of the individual flower stalks, cm (0 for spikes and catkins). Applies when: kind not in ('Solitary', 'Spike', 'Catkin').

pedicel_angle_deg.description: From the rachis Applies when: kind != 'Solitary'.

divergence_deg.description: Angle between successive flowers around the rachis, degrees (137.5 spiral). Applies when: kind not in ('Solitary', 'Umbel').

branch_start.description: Fraction of the rachis below the first lateral Applies when: kind == 'Panicle'.

branch_length_ratio.description: Length of panicle branches relative to the rachis. Applies when: kind == 'Panicle'.

branch_angle_deg.description: Angle of panicle branches from the rachis, degrees. Applies when: kind == 'Panicle'.

branch_umbels.description: Laterals end in umbellate clusters (Agave) Applies when: kind == 'Panicle'.

maturation.description: Acropetal opening gradient (0 all open .. 1 apical buds) Applies when: kind != 'Solitary'.

nodding.description: Flowers turn downward (0 facing out/up .. 1 pendent)

droop.description: Whole axis arches / hangs (catkins, Robinia, Echeveria)

stem_radius_mm.description: Radius of the peduncle at its base, mm.

stem_color.description: Colour of peduncle, rachis and pedicels, sRGB 0..1.

site_mode.description: Where inflorescences go on a plant: Terminal (shoot tips, rosette centre) or Axillary (along shoots, leaf axils).

orientation.description: On plants: 0 along the shoot .. 1 vertical (upright candles)

formula.description: Floral formula (K calyx, C corolla, P tepals, A stamens, G carpels), e.g. 'K5 C5 A∞ G∞'.

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

FlowerPreset.description: Trait values of a Flower preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

mode.description: How the stem uses its guide path: 'Twining' coils around it (the guide is the support), 'Tendril' follows it and grasps it with tendrils, 'Clinging' is pressed to it by rootlets (walls), 'Trailing' creeps along it on the ground.

chirality.description: Handedness of the twining helix: 'Right' = counter-clockwise seen from above (about 90 % of twiners: Ipomoea, Phaseolus, Wisteria sinensis); 'Left' = clockwise (Humulus, Lonicera). Applies when: mode == 'Twining'.

coil_radius_cm.description: Helix radius around the guide (support radius + stem) Applies when: mode == 'Twining'.

coil_pitch_cm.description: Rise per helix turn along the guide Applies when: mode == 'Twining'.

wander_cm.description: Lateral meander of the stem around the guide

tip_length_cm.description: Free searcher tip beyond the reached part of the guide

tip_hook.description: Apical hook / nutation curl of the free tip Applies when: tip_length_cm > 0.

stem_taper.description: Fraction of the radius lost toward the tip

leaf_arrangement.description: Leaves on the stem (the leaf itself is described by the 'leaf' section)

leaf_size.description: Scale of mature leaves relative to the leaf blade length

young_leaf_size.description: Size of the youngest leaf relative to a mature one

expansion_zone_cm.description: Length behind the apex over which internodes and leaves expand

leaf_facing.description: How strongly laminae turn away from the support, toward the light

basal_leaf_loss.description: Fraction of the stem (from the base) that has shed its leaves

branch_probability.description: Chance that a node bears a lateral shoot

branch_length_cm.description: Length of a lateral shoot from an old node, cm (shorter near the apex). Applies when: branch_probability > 0.

branch_angle_deg.description: Insertion angle from the stem Applies when: branch_probability > 0.

branch_droop.description: Gravity bending of unsupported lateral shoots Applies when: branch_probability > 0.

tendril_length_cm.description: Tendril length when straight, cm (Pisum 5-10, Cucumis 15-25, Vitis 10-20). Applies when: tendril_mode != 'None'.

tendril_branches.description: Simple (1) or branched (Vitis 2, Pisum 3-5) Applies when: tendril_mode != 'None'.

tendril_coils.description: Turns of a free tendril's coiled tip Applies when: tendril_mode != 'None' and tendril_reach < 1.

tendril_radius_mm.description: Tendril thickness (radius), mm. Applies when: tendril_mode != 'None'.

tendril_reach.description: Fraction of tendrils that have caught the support Applies when: tendril_mode != 'None'.

aerial_roots.description: Density of rootlets at the nodes

rootlet_length_cm.description: Length of the nodal / adventitious rootlets, cm. Applies when: aerial_roots > 0.

woodiness.description: Fraction of the stem, from the base, that is lignified

VineProfile.description: Habit of a climbing or trailing plant. Lengths are absolute; the guide sets the overall extent.

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

VinePreset.description: Trait values of a Vine preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

kind.description: Fruit type (Spjut 1994): Berry, Drupe, Pome, Hesperidium (citrus), Balausta (pomegranate), Pepo (cucurbits), Pod. Informative; the shape comes from the other fields.

distal_point.description: Extra point at the blossom end (lemon, chilli)

neck.description: Constriction toward the stalk (pear, bottle gourd)

stalk_cavity.description: Depth of the stalk cavity relative to the length (apple ~0.15)

calyx_basin.description: Depth of the distal basin relative to the length (apple ~0.08)

rib_depth.description: Groove depth relative to the radius Applies when: ribs > 0.

lopsided.description: One side larger than the other (apples)

crown_flare_deg.description: 0 = along the axis (closed) .. 90 = spread flat over the fruit Applies when: crown_lobes > 0.

crown_position.description: Where the persistent calyx sits: 'Distal' (blossom end: apple, pomegranate) or 'Proximal' (a star on the stalk end: tomato, aubergine). Applies when: crown_lobes > 0.

crown_color.description: Colour of the calyx lobes (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: crown_lobes > 0.

stalk_radius_mm.description: Stalk radius, mm; for bunches, the radius of the peduncle and rachis.

stalk_color.description: Colour of the stalk, peduncle and pedicels.

cluster_width_cm.description: Width at the shoulders Applies when: cluster_berries > 1.

shoulders.description: Enlarged basal laterals (wings) Applies when: cluster_berries > 1.

compactness.description: 0 loose, straggly .. 1 tightly packed Applies when: cluster_berries > 1.

blush_color.description: Over-colour on the sun side (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: blush > 0.

stripe_count.description: Around the fruit (apple streaks ~30, watermelon ~16) Applies when: stripes > 0.

stripe_width.description: Share of each period covered: 0.15 fine streaks .. 0.5 broad bands Applies when: stripes > 0.

stripe_color.description: Colour of the streaks / stripes. Applies when: stripes > 0.

dot_color.description: Colour of the lenticels, oil glands or speckles. Applies when: dots > 0.

FruitProfile.description: Shape and surface of a fleshy fruit (sizes in cm, along the stalk-to-blossom axis).

scientific_name.description: Binomial name of the plant bearing the fruit, e.g. 'Malus domestica'.

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

FruitPreset.description: Trait values of a Fruit preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

organ.description: Storage or harvested organ: 'Taproot' (carrot, radish, beet, turnip), 'Tubers' (potato), 'Head' (cauliflower, broccoli, Romanesco) or 'None' (leaves only).

stem_radius_mm.description: Radius of the stems at the base, mm. Applies when: stem_height_cm > 0.

leaf_size.description: Scale of the leaves relative to the leaf blade length

head_wrap.description: Brassicas: inner leaves curl up around the head Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

root_length_cm.description: Length of the swollen root from the crown to the start of the tail, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

root_diameter_cm.description: Largest diameter of the storage root, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

widest_position.description: 0 crown .. 1 tip (carrot near the top, beet ~0.5) Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

shoulder.description: Roundness of the top: 0.2 square .. 1 pointed Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

taper.description: Below the widest point: 0.4 rounded (beet) .. 1 conical (carrot) .. 2 slender Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

exposure.description: Fraction of the root standing above the soil Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

tail_cm.description: Length of the thin root below the swollen part, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

rings.description: Horizontal growth rings / wrinkles Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

rootlets.description: Density of lateral rootlets Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

rootlet_ranks.description: Vertical rows of rootlets Applies when: organ == 'Taproot' and rootlets > 0.

root_color.description: Skin colour of the root below the soil (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

tip_color.description: Lower part (white-tipped radish) Applies when: organ == 'Taproot'.

tuber_count.description: Number of tubers per plant. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

tuber_length_cm.description: Tuber length from the heel (stolon end) to the rose end, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

tuber_diameter_cm.description: Largest tuber diameter, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

tuber_depth_cm.description: Depth of the tubers below the soil surface, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

stolon_length_cm.description: Length of the stolons that carry the tubers, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

eyes.description: Number of eyes (buds) per tuber, on a ~2/5 spiral crowded toward the rose end. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

eye_depth.description: Depth of the eye dimples relative to the radius. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

tuber_color.description: Tuber skin colour (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

tuber_dots.description: Density of the lenticel dots on the tuber skin. Applies when: organ == 'Tubers'.

head_type.description: 'Curd' (cauliflower: packed meristem domes), 'Buds' (broccoli: flower-bud clusters on branches) or 'Cones' (Romanesco: self-similar cones). Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

head_diameter_cm.description: Diameter of the head, cm. Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

head_height_ratio.description: Dome height / diameter (Romanesco ~0.9: a cone) Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

head_levels.description: Orders of branching shown Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

florets.description: Branches of the first order (Fibonacci numbers suit the spirals) Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

floret_scale.description: Size of a branch relative to its parent Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

bud_size_mm.description: Broccoli buds Applies when: organ == 'Head' and head_type == 'Buds'.

head_color.description: Colour of the curd, buds or cones (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

branch_color.description: Colour of the head branches and of its base (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: organ == 'Head'.

VegetableProfile.description: Habit and storage organ of a vegetable. Sizes in cm unless noted.

scientific_name.description: Binomial name, e.g. 'Daucus carota subsp. sativus'.

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

VegetablePreset.description: Trait values of a Vegetable preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

tillers.description: Shoots of the clump: the main shoot plus its tillers (maize 1, wheat 3-6, rice 8-15, lawn tufts 20-40).

tiller_variation.description: Tillers are shorter than the main shoot by up to this fraction

flowering_tillers.description: Share of tillers that elongate a culm and flower (others stay leafy)

clump_radius_cm.description: Radius of the base of the clump, cm.

culm_height_m.description: Base to the top of the culm (inflorescence excluded)

culm_radius_mm.description: Culm (stem) radius at the base, mm.

nodes.description: Elongated internodes / leaves on the culm

basal_leaves.description: Extra leaves crowded at the base (tufts, rosettes)

node_swell.description: Swelling of the culm at the nodes

growth_ring.description: Narrow ring just above the node, slightly constricted (sugarcane)

bud_groove.description: Groove up each internode on the side of its axillary bud (maize, cane)

bud_size_mm.description: Axillary bud ("eye") in the axil of each leaf

zigzag_deg.description: The culm turns slightly at each node, alternately

wax_band.description: Whitish waxy band just below each node (sugarcane, sorghum)

node_color.description: Colour of the node ring and root band (sRGB 0..1).

leaf_length_cm.description: Length of the longest blade (from the ligule), cm.

leaf_width_cm.description: Width of the widest blade, cm.

leaf_peak.description: Position along the culm of the longest leaf (0 base .. 1 flag leaf)

leaf_angle_deg.description: Insertion angle between blade and culm

leaf_droop.description: Bending of the blade under its weight (0 stiff .. 1 hanging)

sheath_fraction.description: Share of the internode wrapped by the sheath

leaf_loss.description: Share of the nodes, from the base, whose leaves have died and fallen

midrib_color.description: Colour of the midrib (pale in maize and sorghum).

head.description: Inflorescence: 'Spike' (wheat, barley), 'Panicle' (oats, rice, sorghum), 'Plume' (pampas and fountain grass), 'One-sided' (Bouteloua), 'Maize' (tassel and ears) or 'None' (leafy tufts, lawn).

head_length_cm.description: Length of the spike, panicle, plume, one-sided spikes or tassel, cm. Applies when: head != 'None'.

head_width_cm.description: Width of a panicle or plume, cm. Applies when: head in ('Panicle', 'Plume').

peduncle_cm.description: Bare culm above the flag leaf Applies when: head != 'None'.

spikelets.description: Spikelets per head (spikes, panicles) or hairs of a plume. Applies when: head != 'None'.

spikelet_mm.description: Spikelet length, mm. Applies when: head != 'None'.

awn_cm.description: Awn length (barley ~12, durum ~8, bread wheat 0-5) Applies when: head in ('Spike', 'Panicle', 'One-sided').

branches.description: Panicle whorls / one-sided spikes / tassel branches Applies when: head in ('Panicle', 'Plume', 'One-sided', 'Maize').

nod.description: Head nodding (oats, rice, ripe barley) Applies when: head != 'None'.

head_color.description: Colour of the spikelets (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: head != 'None'.

awn_color.description: Colour of the awns and plume hairs. Applies when: head != 'None' and (awn_cm > 0 or head == 'Plume').

ears.description: Maize ears per plant (the upper one largest). Applies when: head == 'Maize'.

ear_node.description: Position of the (upper) ear along the culm Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

ear_length_cm.description: Maize ear (cob) length, cm. Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

ear_diameter_cm.description: Maize ear diameter, cm. Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

kernel_rows.description: Rows of kernels around the cob (even, 8-24). Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

husk.description: 0 closed in husk leaves .. 1 husk peeled back Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

silk_cm.description: Length of the silks out of the ear tip, cm. Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

kernel_color.description: Kernel colour (sRGB 0..1). Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

silk_color.description: Silk colour. Applies when: head == 'Maize' and ears > 0.

brace_roots.description: Prop roots from the lowest nodes (maize)

GrassProfile.description: Habit of a grass. Lengths in cm unless noted (culm height in m).

notes.description: Free text: distinctive features, sources of the values.

GrassPreset.description: Trait values of a Grass preset (all optional when 'base' is given).

growths.description: Sympodial growths (pseudobulbs / fans) along the rhizome Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

rhizome_cm.description: Rhizome length between successive growths Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

growth_angle_deg.description: The rhizome turns alternately by this angle at each growth (zigzag) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

leafless_growths.description: Oldest growths that have shed their leaves (backbulbs) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

stem_length_cm.description: Monopodial stem; climbing: length of the vine Applies when: habit != 'Sympodial'.

internode_cm.description: Between leaves along a stem or cane Applies when: habit != 'Sympodial' or leaf_placement == 'Along'.

pseudobulb_cm.description: Pseudobulb length (0 = none) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

bulb_widest.description: Position of the widest point (0.3 ovoid .. 0.8 club-shaped) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial' and pseudobulb_cm > 0.

bulb_fullness.description: 0.2 cylindrical cane .. 1 spindle / egg Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial' and pseudobulb_cm > 0.

bulb_flatten.description: Lateral compression (Oncidium, Prosthechea) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial' and pseudobulb_cm > 0.

bulb_ridges.description: Longitudinal ridges and furrows (sulcate pseudobulbs) Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial' and pseudobulb_cm > 0.

bulb_lean_deg.description: Lean of the growths away from the rhizome axis Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial'.

sheath_cover.description: Share of the pseudobulb covered by papery sheaths, from the base Applies when: habit == 'Sympodial' and pseudobulb_cm > 0.

support_height_m.description: Climbing: height of the post the vine climbs Applies when: habit == 'Climbing'.

stem_color.description: Colour of stems, canes, pseudobulbs and rhizome (sRGB 0..1).

sheath_color.description: Colour of the papery sheaths, dry node rings and bracts (sRGB 0..1).

leaf_length_cm.description: Length of the largest (oldest) leaves, cm.

leaf_width_cm.description: Width of the leaves at their widest point, cm.

leaf_droop.description: Arching of the blade under its weight

leaf_twist_deg.description: Random twist along the leaf, degrees.

leaf_size_gradient.description: Youngest leaves smaller by this fraction

root_diameter_mm.description: Thick roots: velamen around the cortex

root_length_cm.description: Length of the aerial roots, cm.

root_wander.description: Meandering of the agravitropic aerial roots

aerial_share.description: Share of the roots growing in the air (others go into the substrate) Applies when: habit != 'Climbing'.

inflorescences.description: Number of inflorescences (spikes, racemes, panicles or node clusters).

flowers.description: Flowers per inflorescence (per branch when branched)

spike_radius_mm.description: Radius of the inflorescence axis at its base, mm.

spike_flex.description: 0 stiff, erect .. 1 pendent under the weight of the flowers

branch_ratio.description: Branch length relative to the rachis Applies when: branches > 0.

flower_facing.description: 0 facing away from the axis .. 1 all turned to the light

maturation.description: Acropetal opening: share of buds at the tip

spike_color.description: Colour of peduncle, rachis, pedicels and ovaries (sRGB 0..1).

fruit_set.description: Share of flowers replaced by capsules (pods)

resupination.description: 1 lip lowermost (gravitropic twist of the ovary) .. 0 lip uppermost

sepal_width_cm.description: Width of the dorsal sepal, cm.

sepal_widest.description: Position of the widest point of the sepals, 0 base .. 1 tip.

sepal_apex_deg.description: Angle at the sepal apex, degrees (small = acuminate, 180 = rounded).

lateral_sepal_deg.description: Lateral sepals below the horizontal Applies when: synsepal < 0.85.

synsepal.description: Lateral sepals joined behind the lip (Paphiopedilum: 1)

sepal_cup.description: Transverse concavity of the sepals (negative: margins recurved).

sepal_twist_deg.description: Twist along the sepals, degrees (Prosthechea: twisted, hanging).

petal_length_cm.description: Length of the lateral petals, cm.

petal_width_cm.description: Width of the lateral petals, cm.

petal_widest.description: Position of the widest point of the petals, 0 base .. 1 tip.

petal_apex_deg.description: Angle at the petal apex, degrees (small = acuminate, 180 = rounded).

petal_claw.description: Narrow stalk-like base (fraction of the length)

petal_cup.description: Transverse concavity of the petals (negative: margins recurved).

petal_reflex_deg.description: Bending back along the petals, degrees.

petal_twist_deg.description: Twist along the petals, degrees (Paphiopedilum, Prosthechea).

perianth_forward_deg.description: Tepals raised forward from the floral plane (cupped flowers)

lip_width_cm.description: Across the spread lateral lobes (or the whole lip)

lip_angle_deg.description: Base direction below the floral axis (0 forward .. 90 straight down)

lip_deflex_deg.description: Further bending down along the lip (recurved mid lobe)

lip_claw.description: Half-width of the narrow base, relative to the lip

side_lobes.description: Lateral lobes, relative half-width (0 = entire lip)

side_lobe_pos.description: Their centre along the lip Applies when: side_lobes > 0.

side_lobe_length.description: Their extent along the lip Applies when: side_lobes > 0.

side_lobe_erect_deg.description: Fold of the lateral lobes up around the column Applies when: side_lobes > 0.

midlobe_width.description: Mid lobe width relative to the lip width Applies when: side_lobes > 0.

isthmus.description: Narrowing between lateral lobes and mid lobe (pandurate lips) Applies when: side_lobes > 0.

lip_widest.description: Position of the widest point of the mid lobe (or entire lip), 0 base .. 1 apex.

lip_apex_deg.description: Angle at the lip apex, degrees (small = pointed, 180 = rounded).

lip_roll.description: 0 flat .. 1 rolled into a tube around the column

lip_roll_extent.description: Share of the lip that is rolled, from the base Applies when: lip_roll > 0.

lip_waves.description: Waves along the margin Applies when: lip_wave > 0.

callus_mm.description: Height of the callus (pad or ridges) on the lip disc

callus_ridges.description: 0 one fleshy pad; >0 parallel keels (lamellae) Applies when: callus_mm > 0.

callus_pos.description: Centre of the callus along the lip Applies when: callus_mm > 0.

cirrhi_mm.description: Two filiform appendages at the lip apex (Phalaenopsis)

column_arch.description: Arching of the column toward the lip

mentum_mm.description: Chin formed by the column foot and the lateral sepals (Dendrobium)

sepal_color.description: Flower colours and pigmentation patterns (full colour, spots, venation: PeMYB2 / 11 / 12, Hsu et al. 2015)

lip_throat_color.description: Colour of the lip base / throat (inside a tube) (sRGB 0..1).

callus_color.description: Colour of the callus, ridges and cirrhi (sRGB 0..1).

anther_color.description: Colour of the anther cap and staminode (sRGB 0..1).

pattern_color.description: Colour of spots, bars and venation (anthocyanin) (sRGB 0..1).

tip_amount.description: Coloured tips of sepals, petals and lip (Dendrobium nobile)

spot_stretch.description: >1 transverse bars (Oncidium sepals) Applies when: spots > 0 or lip_spots > 0.

veins.description: Coloured venation on sepals and petals

lip_spots.description: Spots on the lip and callus, 0..1.

sheen.description: Crystalline / waxy sheen of the tepals

OrchidProfile.description: Habit, leaves, roots, inflorescence and flower of an orchid. Lengths in cm unless noted.

notes.description: Free text: habit, distinctive features, sources of the values.

OrchidPreset.description: Trait values of an Orchid preset (all optional when 'base' is given).
